device.description: 24-bit 1 kSPS 4-channel delta-sigma ADC with internal reference and I2C interface
device.note: ads1219.pdf (SBAS924A) p.3 pin functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.7-9 I2C timing and DRDY, p.19 conversion times (Table 4), p.20-21 reset and conversion modes, p.22-23 I2C address (Table 5), DRDY, general call, p.24 data format, p.25-26 commands (Table 7), p.27-29 registers

registers.name: DATA
registers.note: output shift register read after RDATA

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.7-9 (I2C timing, DRDY), p.19 (Table 4 conversion times), p.20-21 (reset, modes), p.22-23 (I2C address, DRDY, general call), p.24 (data format), p.25-26 (commands), p.27-29 (registers)
notModeled: analog input, gain, reference selection (stored only)
STATUS.DRDY is set at each completion but is not cleared when the conversion data are read (the schema has no 'clear another register's bit on result read'); it clears only on reset
conversion times are the single-shot values (Table 4); the continuous-mode period and the 28.5 tCLK first-conversion delay are not modeled

entering continuous mode by writing CM=1 does not need START/SYNC in the model (the datasheet requires START/SYNC after every CM change); a WREG during a conversion does not restart it (the datasheet restarts it)
POWERDOWN during a conversion: the datasheet completes the conversion first
DRDY releases high for tw(DRH) = 2 tMOD before the next result when the previous one was not read; DRDY rises tp(RDDR) = 2 tMOD after the RDATA command is latched (modeled: when the result is read)
RDATA/RREG read-back: the following I2C read returns the selected register MSB first and repeats it if more bytes are read (the datasheet does not say what follows the last byte)
I2C timeout (14000 tMOD) interface reset; I2C bus speed limits; RESET pin timing (tw(RSL), td(RSSTA))
STATUS.ID[6:0] (R-xxh, values subject to change): modeled as 0
variants: The datasheet also shows an RTE (WQFN-16) pinout; the skeleton has no RTE orderable parts.
